note.summary:
3.1 Travel and tourism, including places of interest
Key vocabulary (Simplified Chinese = pinyin = English)
- 旅行 lǚxíng — travel
- 旅游 lǚyóu — tourism
- 景点 jǐngdiǎn — attraction
- 旅馆 lǚguǎn — hotel
- 机票 jīpiào — plane ticket
- 火车 huǒchē — train
- 预订 yùdìng — to book
- 参观 cānguān — to visit

Key grammar
- Use 的 for descriptions and relationships; use 很 for a predicate adjective (她很友好, not *她友好*) where needed.
- Use 了 for a completed past event, 过 for an experienced action, and 在/正在 for an action in progress.
- Time normally goes before the action: 我上周/昨天 + verb; place goes before the main verb when giving a sequence of actions.
- Give reasons with 因为……所以…… and contrast with 虽然……但是……; use 如果……就…… for real conditions.
- Measure words matter: 四口人, 两个朋友, 一本书, 一所学校; use 比 for comparison and 最 for the superlative.

Exam tips
- Include an opinion and a reason; a bare adjective earns less communication than 因为……所以…… .
- Check measure words, negatives (不/没有), and time expressions before answering.
- Natural repetition is fine: accurate familiar vocabulary is better than a guessed rare word.

questions.examTip: Use a visible description, a reasoned opinion and a past or future personal connection; do not stop after naming the people.

去年暑假我坐火车去了上海。

在照片里，我能看到一个与这个话题有关的场景。照片里的人看起来很有兴趣，我觉得这样的活动很有意义，因为可以学到新东西。上个月我也有过类似的经历，希望以后还能再做一次。

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet with a full but concise response; prepare flexible opinion phrases for the unexpected question.

— 我已经参观过长城两次。
— 我对这件事有自己的看法，因为它对我的生活有帮助。
— （临时问题）上次我参加的时候，虽然有一点困难，但是我很高兴，因为学到了新东西。

(English translation: — I have visited the Great Wall twice. — I have an opinion about this because it is helpful in my life. — (Unexpected question) When I took part last time, although it was a little difficult, I was happy because I learned something new.)
